sentences.text: Counsel for Applicant :- Vidit Khanna,Mahadeo Singh Chandel Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Manoj Kumar Tripathi,Vinod Kumar Tirpathi Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the bail application the applicants have prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
0177 of 2023 at Police Station- Kotwali Dehat, District- Bijnor under Sections 498A, 304B, 323 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicants are in jail since 20.08.2023.
The bail application of the applicants was rejected by the learned trial court on 05.10.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Mahadeo Singh Chandel, learned counsel on behalf of the applicants, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Sri Shravan Kumar Mishra, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicants for grant of bail:

sentences.text: 1. The applicants are the mother-in-law and father-in-law of the deceased respectively.
2. The applicants do not harass the deceased or demand dowry.
3. The applicants never interfered in the marital life of the deceased and her husband.
4. The applicants were residing separately from the deceased and her husband.
5. The deceased was a temperamental lady who was prone to extreme reactions over trivial issues.
6. On the fateful day after an argument with her husband over a minor issue, she flew into a fit of rage and took the extreme step of ending her life.
She committed suicide by hanging.
7. The postmortem report opines the cause of death as asphyxia due to antemortem hanging.

8. Injuries depicted in the postmortem report consistent with hanging are:
(i) Nature of ligature mark.
(ii) The hyoid bone was intact.
9. The applicants do not aid or abet the suicide.
10. Prosecution evidence do not connect the applicants with the offence.
11. The prerequisites for attracting the presumption and the reversing the burden of proof are not established in the facts and circumstances and evidence of the case.
12. The applicants have explained their criminal history.
It is also contended that the applicants belong to the economically poor strata of the society and are a convenient scapegoat for the police authorities.
The applicants have been falsely nominated in a case only to show the proficiency of the police investigators.
The said case does not have any bearing on the instant bail application.
13. The applicants are not flight risk.
The applicants being law abiding citizen have always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of their influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-

(ii) The applicants will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
